title: Ashbury Rewards Points Ledger: Largest Points Purchase and Its Price
content:
How many points an Ashbury Rewards member who asks to buy the most points they are allowed buys, and the price charged, rest on the definitions below.

## Definitions

**P1 — Points bought.** A member who asks to buy the most points they are allowed buys, in one purchase, the remaining purchase allowance rounded down to a multiple of the tier's points purchase increment.

**P2 — Purchase allowance.** The purchase allowance is the points purchase annual cap of the tier.

**P3 — Remaining purchase allowance.** The remaining purchase allowance is the purchase allowance less the points bought in the twelve months before the handling date, never below zero.

**P4 — Price per thousand points.** The price per thousand points is the tier's points purchase price per 1,000 points.

**P5 — Price of the purchase.** The price of the purchase is the points bought divided by one thousand times the price per thousand points, rounded to two decimal places, before any sales tax.

**P6 — Periods.** The twelve months before the handling date are the transactions posted after the same day number twelve months earlier, up to and including the handling date.

## Worked figure (hypothetical member)

| Line | Value |
|---|---|
| Points purchase annual cap of the tier, taken as | 100000 |
| Points bought in the twelve months | 35500 |
| Remaining purchase allowance (P3) | 64500 |
| Purchase increment of the tier, taken as | 1000 |
| Points bought (P1) | 64000 |
| Price per thousand points of the tier, taken as | 12.50 USD |
| Price (P5) | 64000 divided by 1000 is 64, times 12.50 is 800.00 USD before tax |
